conf.description: OpenShift node/container syslog-raw (RFC5424): un-frame the header, MSG is the plain message text (not JSON). MSGID carries the container/node discriminator, used to route PROCID to kubernetes.pod.id or process.pid. Namespace/pod/container cannot be reliably split out of the underscore-joined APP-NAME (see README gap).

conf.comment: OpenShift node/container logs via ClusterLogForwarder syslog output. Un-frame RFC5424; MSG is the plain log line. MSGID (container/node) discriminates PROCID's meaning (pod UID vs PID). APP-NAME's namespace_pod_container packing is not split - no documented delimiter algorithm; use the json feed if that identity is required.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and parsing approach
strip the RFC5424 frame: PRI, TIMESTAMP, HOSTNAME, APP-NAME, PROCID, MSGID, MSG
batch the mapped header fields to their ECS targets

decompose PRI, promote log_source, route PROCID to pod.id or PID by the container/node discriminator, set _time from the header timestamp (no more-authoritative time exists in a plain-text MSG), tag event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
